name: Evening The
overview: The concept of 'Evening The' in Scripture is closely associated with the period marking the end of the day, often referred to as 'the even.' The sample verses from Leviticus reveal that individuals who become ceremonially unclean remain so until the evening, emphasizing the evening as a significant boundary for ritual purity. This time also relates to daily practices such as washing and bathing to restore cleanliness, highlighting the evening as a divinely appointed moment for restoration and transition from impurity to readiness for worship and daily living.
